substeps.caption: A Raspberry Pi 5 with two cameras, as the lab's own units in DAL PR #189: an HQ Camera with a 16 mm M12 lens beside a Camera Module 3 Wide, the Pi 5 and its Active Cooler behind them in a black PETG box.
It tilts on a 1/4-20 joint at the top of a 2020 post: down onto the instrument it watches.
The Wide sees 102 x 67 degrees; the HQ with its 16 mm lens about 22 x 17 degrees, the detail. One PoE cable carries power and the stream.
